goals: Use advanced pasts and the conditional naturally

lessons.title: Advanced past: tinha feito
lessons.learn: Going deeper back: TINHA FEITO = I had done (before something else). TINHA + past participle: TINHA COMIDO, TINHA VIAJADO. Tell layered stories!

grammar.title: Pluperfect: tinha + participle
grammar.explain: TINHA + participle = HAD done: TINHA FEITO, TINHA COMIDO, TINHA VIAJADO. Use when one past happened before another: Quando cheguei, TINHA COMIDO = When I arrived, I had (already) eaten.

examples.en: When I arrived, he had left.
I had already eaten.
I had never seen that.

mistakes: Using pretérito for the earlier event: TINHA SAÍDO for had-left.
Forgetting JÁ: já + tinha = already had — natural pair!

dialogue.t: Quando cheguei, você já tinha saído!
dialogue.r: KWAHN-doo sheh-GAY, voh-SEH zhah CHEE-nyah seh-EE-doo!
dialogue.en: When I arrived, you had already left!

dialogue.t: Desculpa! Eu tinha uma reunião cedo.
dialogue.r: desh-KOOL-pah! eh-oo CHEE-nyah OO-mah heh-oo-NYOW(n) SEH-doo.
dialogue.en: Sorry! I had an early meeting.

dialogue.t: Tudo bem. De repente choveu!
dialogue.r: TOO-doo bay(n). dee heh-PEHN-chee shoh-VEH-oo!
dialogue.en: No problem. Suddenly it rained!

dialogue.t: Que azar!
dialogue.r: kee ah-ZAHR!
dialogue.en: What bad luck!

lessons.title: Would: falaria
lessons.learn: Dream-grammar! FALARIA = I would speak. Infinitive + -IA: VIAJARIA, COMERIA, SERIA. With SE (if): SE PUDESSE, VIAJARIA = If I could, I would travel.

grammar.title: Conditional: falaria (would speak)
grammar.explain: Add -IA to the infinitive: FALAR + IA = FALARIA. EU/VOCÊ/ELE all FALARIA. Perfect for dreams, wishes, polite requests: EU ADORARIA = I would love to!

examples.en: I would travel the world.
I would love to visit Brazil.
That would be great!

mistakes: Saying GOSTARIA for would-travel: VIAJARIA is would travel; gostaria is would like.
Forgetting the R: viaj-A-RIA keeps the whole infinitive.

lessons.title: Hipóteses no passado: se tivesse…
lessons.learn: An unreal past condition has two halves that must agree: se + imperfect subjunctive (tivesse, fosse, pudesse) and the conditional with teria + participle (teria feito, teria sido). Swap either half and the sentence stops being an unreal condition — it becomes a promise about the future or a plain statement of fact.

grammar.title: Unreal past conditions
grammar.pattern: se tivesse sabido, teria avisado · caso tivesse tempo, teria ido
grammar.explain: Se + imperfeito do subjuntivo states the unreal past; the other half takes teria + participle. Caso is the formal variant and also takes the subjunctive (caso tivesse). The order can be reversed with no change of meaning, and a comma marks the swap.

examples.t: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria avisado antes.
examples.r: see eh-oo tee-VEHS-see sah-BEE-doo, teh-REE-ah ah-vee-ZAH-doo AH(n)-jees.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have warned you earlier.

examples.t: Caso houvesse prazo, teríamos entregue a versão completa.
examples.r: KAH-zoo oh-VEHS-see PRAH-zoo, teh-REE-ah-moos en-treh-GEH ah vehr-ZOW(n) koh(n)-PLEH-tah.
examples.en: Had there been a deadline, we would have delivered the full version.

examples.t: Teria sido melhor esperar, mas a decisão já estava tomada.
examples.r: teh-REE-ah SEE-doo meh-LYOHR es-peh-RAHR, mahs ah deh-see-ZOW(n) zhah es-TAH-vah toh-MAH-dah.
examples.en: It would have been better to wait, but the decision was already made.

mistakes.wrong: Se eu teria sabido, teria avisado.
mistakes.right: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria avisado.
mistakes.why: The se half takes the imperfect subjunctive, never the conditional.

mistakes.wrong: Se eu tivesse sabido, avisaria antes.
mistakes.right: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria avisado antes.
mistakes.why: Teria + participle is the form for an unreal past result.

dialogue.t: Você teria feito diferente?
dialogue.r: voh-SEH teh-REE-ah FEH-too jee-feh-REHN-jee?
dialogue.en: Would you have done it differently?

dialogue.t: Se eu tivesse visto os números antes, teria pedido mais prazo.
dialogue.r: see eh-oo tee-VEHS-see VEES-too oos NOO-meh-roos AH(n)-jees, teh-REE-ah peh-DEE-doo mays PRAH-zoo.
dialogue.en: If I had seen the numbers earlier, I would have asked for more time.

dialogue.t: E caso tivessem negado?
dialogue.r: ee KAH-zoo tee-VEHS-sem neh-GAH-doo?
dialogue.en: And had they refused?

dialogue.t: Aí teríamos refeito a proposta do zero.
dialogue.r: ah-EE teh-REE-ah-moos heh-FAY-too ah proh-POHS-tah doo ZEH-roo.
dialogue.en: Then we would have redone the proposal from scratch.

lessons.title: Subjunctive basics: que eu fale
lessons.learn: Feelings and doubts unlock a new mood! ESPERO QUE VOCÊ FALE = I hope you speak — FALE not FALA! Doubt, hope, wishing: QUE + subjunctive. -AR verbs flip A→E!

grammar.title: QUE + subjunctive: que eu fale
grammar.explain: After hope/doubt/wishing (ESPERO QUE, DUVIDO QUE), -AR verbs flip A→E: FALA→FALE, VIAJA→VIAJE. Small flip, huge fluency leap!

examples.en: I hope you speak Portuguese.
I doubt he will come.
It is important that you study.

mistakes: Using FALA after ESPERO QUE — flip to FALE!
Using subjunctive after SEI QUE (I know) — facts stay normal!

dialogue.t: Espero que você goste do Brasil!
dialogue.r: sh-PEH-roo kee voh-SEH GOHSH-chee doo brah-ZEE-oo!
dialogue.en: I hope you like Brazil!

dialogue.t: Tomara! É importante que eu pratique.
dialogue.r: too-MAH-rah! eh ee(m)-pohr-TAHN-chee kee eh-oo prah-CHEE-kee.
dialogue.en: Let's hope! It is important that I practise.

dialogue.t: Duvido que seja difícil para você.
dialogue.r: doo-VEE-doo kee SEH-zhah dee-FEE-see-oo pah-rah voh-SEH.
dialogue.en: I doubt it will be hard for you.

dialogue.t: Obrigado!
dialogue.r: oh-bree-GAH-doo!
dialogue.en: Thanks!

lessons.title: Debating and disagreeing
lessons.learn: Debate like a Brazilian! CONCORDO (I agree), DISCORDO (I disagree), POR OUTRO LADO (on the other hand), ALÉM DISSO (besides), NO ENTANTO (however). Pick a side and defend it!

grammar.title: Debate connectors: glue for arguments
grammar.explain: Connectors chain ideas: PORQUE (because) explains, MAS (but) contrasts, ALÉM DISSO adds, NO ENTANTO concedes. Chain 3+ for real B2 fluency: CONCORDO, MAS… ALÉM DISSO…

examples.en: I agree, but it is expensive.
I disagree because it is unfair.

examples.t: É bom; além disso, é barato.
examples.r: eh boh(n); ah-LAY(m) DEE-soo, eh bah-RAH-too.
examples.en: It is good; besides, it is cheap.

mistakes: Stopping at CONCORDO — add PORQUE + a reason!
Using MAS twice in one sentence — vary with NO ENTANTO.

dialogue.t: Acho que o metrô é melhor que o carro.
dialogue.r: AH-shoo kee oo meh-TROH eh meh-LYOHR kee oo KAH-hoo.

lessons.title: Argumentar por escrito: conectores formais
lessons.learn: Written argument in Portuguese moves by connectives that carry a claim about the relation between ideas: portanto concludes, contudo contrasts, na medida em que explains by degree, dado que supplies a premise. A paragraph with four connectives of the same type reads as a list; a paragraph that varies them reads as an argument.

grammar.title: Connectives of argument
grammar.pattern: dado que … · portanto … · contudo … · na medida em que …
grammar.explain: Dado que and visto que present a premise the reader is expected to accept. Portanto and por conseguinte draw the conclusion. Contudo, no entanto and ainda assim mark the turn. Na medida em that is a claim of proportion, not a synonym of porque — it says one thing grows with the other.

examples.t: Dado que a amostra é pequena, os resultados pedem cautela.
examples.r: DAH-doo kee ah ah-MOHS-trah eh peh-KEH-nah, oos heh-zoo-oo-TAH-doos PEH-jay(n) kow-TEH-lah.
examples.en: Given that the sample is small, the results call for caution.

examples.t: Os dados cresceram; contudo, o ritmo segue desigual.
examples.r: oos DAH-doos kreh-SEH-rah(n); koh(n)-TOO-doo, oo HEETCH-moo SEH-gee deh-zee-GOO-ah-oo.
examples.en: The figures grew; however, the pace remains uneven.

examples.t: O acesso melhora na medida em que a rede chega ao interior.
examples.r: oo ah-SEH-soo meh-LYOH-rah nah meh-DEE-dah ey(n) kee ah HEH-jee SHEH-gah ah-oo een-teh-ree-OHR.
examples.en: Access improves to the extent that the network reaches the interior.

mistakes.wrong: Porque a amostra é pequena, portanto os resultados pedem cautela.
mistakes.right: Dado que a amostra é pequena, os resultados pedem cautela.
mistakes.why: Use one premise marker and one conclusion marker, not two premises.

mistakes.wrong: O acesso melhora na medida que a rede chega.
mistakes.right: O acesso melhora na medida em que a rede chega.
mistakes.why: The fixed form is na medida em que.

lessons.title: Brazilian culture and SAUDADE
lessons.learn: Culture time! FEIJOADA (bean stew), SAMBA, CARNAVAL, FUTEBOL. And SAUDADE — the untranslatable ache of missing someone: TENHO SAUDADES DE VOCÊ = I miss you. Brazilians LIVE this word!

To satisfy the longing (meet again).

lessons.title: Cinema e crítica cultural
lessons.learn: A cultural review is an argument with a stated scope. The frame o que me interessa é names what the critic is reading for; peca por + infinitive names the defect without insult; the concession embora reconheça keeps the positive in view. A review that only approves or only condemns has not yet said what it is looking at.

grammar.title: Reviewing a work
grammar.pattern: o que me interessa é … · peca por + infinitive · embora reconheça …
grammar.explain: The frame o que me interessa é + noun clause shifts the review to what the critic actually read. Peca por + infinitive names a fault precisely: peca por explicar demais. Embora + subjunctive concedes the other side without abandoning the thesis.

examples.t: O que me interessa no filme é a relação entre pai e filha.
examples.r: oo kee mee een-teh-REH-sah noo FEE-oo-mee eh ah heh-lah-SOW(n) EH(n)-tree PAH-ee ee FEE-lyah.
examples.en: What interests me in the film is the relationship between father and daughter.

examples.t: O roteiro peca por explicar o que a cena já mostra.
examples.r: oo hoh-TAY-ree-oo PEH-kah pohr es-plee-KAHR oo kee ah SEH-nah zhah MOH-trah.
examples.en: The script falls short by explaining what the scene already shows.

examples.t: Embora reconheça o mérito da atuação, a crítica mantém a ressalva.
examples.r: ey(n)-BOH-rah heh-koh-NYEH-sah oo MEH-ree-too dah ah-too-ah-SOW(n), ah KREE-tee-kah mahn-TEH(n) ah heh-SAH-oo-vah.
examples.en: Although it acknowledges the acting, the review keeps its reservation.

mistakes.wrong: O filme peca por que explica demais.
mistakes.right: O filme peca por explicar demais.
mistakes.why: Peca por takes a bare infinitive, with no que.

mistakes.wrong: Embora reconhece o mérito, mantém a ressalva.

culture.text: Brazilian culture makes its arguments in public: samba was born in the houses of Bahia and grew in the morros of Rio; bossa nova took the same rhythm into a small room and a quiet voice; the MPB of the 1960s and 1970s turned song into political speech, and some of it was written in exile. Literature runs from Machado de Assis, who dissected a society by refusing to flatter it, to Clarice Lispector, who dissected a sentence, and to the cordel leaflets of the Northeast, printed and sold at fairs and still read aloud. To criticise here is not to be against Brazil — it is the local form of taking part.

reading.text: A roda de samba começou às nove, quando o dono do bar empurrou as mesas para a calçada. Ninguém anunciou nada: o cavaquinho tocou dois acordes e todo mundo já sabia a entrada. Havia um senhor de uns oitenta anos que cantava com um chapéu no colo e uma menina de doze que repetia o refrão sem olhar para o violão. Entre uma música e outra, alguém contou que aquele grupo tocava ali desde 1998, e que a prefeitura tinha querido fechar a rua no ano passado. O samba continuou, mais baixo e depois mais alto, até que o dono trouxe água para os músicos e a roda virou conversa.
reading.gloss: The samba circle started at nine, when the bar owner pushed the tables out onto the pavement. Nobody announced anything: the cavaquinho played two chords and everyone already knew the entry. There was a man of about eighty singing with a hat on his lap and a twelve-year-old girl repeating the chorus without looking at the guitar. Between one song and the next, someone said the group had played there since 1998, and that the city government had wanted to close the street last year. The samba went on, quieter and then louder, until the owner brought water for the musicians and the circle turned into a conversation.

listening.script: Você leu a crítica de ontem? — Li, mas discordo do título. — Por quê? — Porque o filme não é sobre a seca; a seca é o cenário. O que me interessa é a relação entre o pai e a filha, e isso a crítica nem menciona.
listening.gloss: Did you read yesterday's review? — I did, but I disagree with the headline. — Why? — Because the film is not about the drought; the drought is the setting. What interests me is the relationship between the father and the daughter, and the review does not even mention it.

mistakes.wrong: Se eu seria rico, eu viajaria.
mistakes.right: Se eu fosse rico, eu viajaria.
mistakes.why: An unreal condition takes the imperfect subjunctive: fosse.
Espero que triggers the present subjunctive.
Preferir que also takes the subjunctive.

task.title: Uma crítica curta com uma tese
task.instructions: Choose a Brazilian song, film or book you know. Write 150 to 200 words with one sentence that states your thesis, two paragraphs that support it from the work itself (quote a line, a scene, a verse), and one concession starting with embora or ainda que. Finish with a sentence that states what your reading does not claim.
